Basic attribution (no URL)
.
> To be, or not to be.
>
> — Shakespeare
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote>
<p>To be, or not to be.</p>
</blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">Shakespeare</figcaption>
</figure>
.

Marker sharing a paragraph with quote text via a soft break
.
> Quote text.
> — Shared Author
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote>
<p>Quote text.</p>
</blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">Shared Author</figcaption>
</figure>
.

Attribution with a bare URL
.
> Quote text.
>
> — Cicero, https://example.com
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote cite="https://example.com">
<p>Quote text.</p>
</blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">Cicero, https://example.com</figcaption>
</figure>
.

Attribution with an inline link
.
> Quote text.
>
> — Cicero, [source](https://example.com)
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote cite="https://example.com">
<p>Quote text.</p>
</blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">Cicero, <a href="https://example.com">source</a></figcaption>
</figure>
.

Attribution with a reference-style link (cite is not set — known v1 limitation)
.
> Quote text.
>
> — Cicero, [source][]

[source]: https://example.com
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote>
<p>Quote text.</p>
</blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">Cicero, <a href="https://example.com">source</a></figcaption>
</figure>
.

Multiple attributed paragraphs in one blockquote (first one wins)
.
> Quote one.
>
> — First
>
> Quote two.
>
> — Second
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote>
<p>Quote one.</p>
<p>Quote two.</p>
<p>— Second</p>
</blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">First</figcaption>
</figure>
.

Unmatched blockquote passes through unmodified
.
> Just a quote.
>
> No marker here.
.
<blockquote>
<p>Just a quote.</p>
<p>No marker here.</p>
</blockquote>
.

Empty quote content (marker on the very first line)
.
> — Just an attribution, no quote
.
<figure class="quote">
<blockquote></blockquote>
<figcaption class="attribution">Just an attribution, no quote</figcaption>
</figure>
.

Nested blockquotes are left alone — only top-level blockquotes get attribution handling
.
> > Inner quote.
> >
> > — Inner Author
>
> Outer text.
.
<blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>Inner quote.</p>
<p>— Inner Author</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Outer text.</p>
</blockquote>
.
